title: The Insane Story Behind the Mercedes 6x6
description:
In March twenty thirteen, Mercedes showed a six-wheeled G 63 AMG and its own spokesman said there was no plan for series production. By February twenty fifteen, more than one hundred had been built and the run was sold out. In between lies an army contract, a price that moved, a production number that moved, and a pickup that Australia could not buy. This is the story, with every claim sourced. We rely on GoAuto, Motor Authority, Autocar, CarAdvice, Wikipedia, Barrett-Jackson, MBWorld, The Classic Valuer, The Drive and Carscoops. Several of them disagree about dates, prices and numbers. Those disagreements are part of the story, so we show them. Our own arithmetic is labelled.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
